notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello Space reavers!

We have a brand new patch for you. What's new :
The new Join Screen.
When players start a new game, they have to choose the devices they will use to play, Xbox 360 gamepad or mouse/keyboard.
http://www.ballisticfrogs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/2015-09-30-19_33_47-Greenshot.png

When players load a saved game, icon will show the joined devices on these saves
http://www.ballisticfrogs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/2015-09-30-19_34_01-Greenshot.png
The save without icons are the one created before the patch 1.0.2. They are totally compatible and will be updated when players will load them.

After choosing a save, players will have a Join screen with colored icon on top of each column. It informs the mandatory device for each players to play this save.
http://www.ballisticfrogs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/joinscreen-saved.png

This step is mandatory to play saved game. It avoids confusion about what device players choose. It also prevents crashes when players load games with different devices.

In campaign mode, there are always at least two sectors that lead towards Earth. It works on previous saved where players are stuck.
Fix Editor menu positions for non 1080p resolutions
Adding new keys for entering hyperspace (I) and rotating sections/guns in the editor (O,P). Previous keys (F1, Pg. Up, Pg. Dw) still work but are not shown any more.
Fix localization
Minor fixes

Thank you for your support and feedback! They are very helpful!

All glory to the RAMPAGE!

The Ballistic Frogs Team.

notes.title: Update Steam 2 - Update 0.16.0 Beta
notes.content:
http://www.ballisticfrogs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/updateSteam2.png
Hello space folks!

This is the... last ! Beta update for Psycho Starship Rampage. The final 1.0 version is coming on Monday! Yes, you read that right. The game is out very, very soon now. But do not worry. We will not abandon Psycho Starship Rampage after its release. You can expect new, free updates after release. We cannot promise you when nor how much, but we are definitely committed to accompanying the game’s life.

So this new version is 0.16.0 Beta.

What’s new?The campaign mode is available! Discover the story of a poor, maddened AI lost in space and hell-bent on destroying everything. Can you reach Earth before you are obliterated?
Achievements have been revamped in depth. You can now unlock the base equipments more quickly, but some high-end loot affixes are going to take some skill. 
New endgame weapons! Subspace Cannon and Black Hole Cannon
New level: Red
New wave patterns
New loot affixes!
New visual effects: particles, assets, animations!
New background music tracks
New sounds: A.I. voices, starship editor 
Balancing
Fixed multiple bugs

To be sure to encounter all the new features, start a new game!

All glory to the rampage! And we shall meet again on Monday :)
